summary: I ran the 22 P3 mutants of test-strategy section 7.4 in scratch roots. Before my test change, 20 died and 2 survived: p3-20 (the A209 leaked stub message) and the extra probe p3-23 (a pattern that hard-codes the A210 count set). I closed both with test-only changes in commit 4d0b4e6b3: case_tsx_exit_0_gate_exits_0 now calls reset_tsx first, and the positive control loops over two valid verdict lines with different counts. After the change, all 22 mutants die, the A210 probe dies, and part A holds 19 cases with floor 19. The required commands exit 0 (doctor gate cases_total=31 cases_failed=0; marker vocabulary cases_total=15 cases_failed=0; catalog PASS A1-A15), and bash -n exits 0. measure/doctor.sh is unchanged since the audited head. No blocking finding remains. The extra probe p3-24 (a pattern that hard-codes the status debt-change) survives, and no realistic fixture closes it, so it stays as a Low test-generality residual.
nonblocking_findings: N1 [open, Low, residual]: a mutant pattern that hard-codes the verdict status `debt-change` survives all 19 part A cases (p3-24, cases_total=19 cases_failed=0). The CLI gives exit 1 only for status debt-change (packages/architecture-enforcement/src/architecture-check.ts:237,251-256). A valid fixture with another status would contradict the CLI contract, so no realistic case closes this gap. The malformed shapes e and f still pin the status shape `[^ ]+` from the other side. The production pattern at measure/doctor.sh:22 is correct; this is a test-generality residual, not a gate defect.

N2 [open, Nit, strategy text]: test-strategy.md:143 says the verdict literal in every case is the single line with files=12, findings=3, parseErrors=0. My A210 fix adds a second valid line with files=1200, findings=17, parseErrors=2 at the positive control. Section 7.4 also needs the reset_tsx note for p3-20. The phase owner should amend these two sentences at closeout. Default: adopt the test as committed; the production rule does not change.

N3 [open, Nit, carried, plan task 3.1]: plan.md:289 keeps a grep check that cannot show the status line (review A A211). The check prints one line at measure/tracks.md:1670. Task 3.1 is open at this phase by the accepted default of test-strategy section 6.9. This is not a defect of the exit 1 rule and not blocking for this gate.

N4 [open, Low, carried, B214]: a newline inside an echoed field could forge a whole verdict-shaped line on a crash exit 1. None of the 22 mutants reaches that path, and the CI push gate fails the same run. Review B holds the detail. Nonblocking.
